pages.title: Cozy Tiles – Relaxing Picture Puzzle
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Drag tiles into their places in Cozy Tiles – Relaxing Picture Puzzle. Use the colors and outlines to rebuild each scene across a hundred pictures and ten chapters.

pages.title: 2048 Bubble Shoot
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Shoot balls into numbered blocks in 2048 Bubble Shoot. Watch them bounce, then collect them through the pipe and merge matching numbers to reach higher values.

pages.title: Arrows Disappear
pages.creator: wavegame
pages.description: Rotate a structure in Arrows Disappear and inspect the arrows on its blocks. Remove pieces that point into open space, then use the gaps to free the ones behind them.

pages.title: Picture by Pieces
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Rebuild pictures by moving blocks in Picture by Pieces. Match lines and colors along neighboring edges and finish the image to open another puzzle.

pages.title: Hidden Object Time Travel
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Search scenes from different eras in Hidden Object Time Travel. Look for treasures in places like dinosaur jungles and future cities, and use hints when you need help.

pages.title: Cute Craft Lab
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Make decorations in Cute Craft Lab. Use the workshop tools to work through each craft, then choose how to finish it with the colors and decorative pieces provided.

pages.title: Find Hidden Cats
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Look for twenty cats in each black-and-white scene in Find Hidden Cats. Search the illustrated European city settings carefully for ears, tails, and other details that give away a hiding place.

pages.title: Find the Frog - Hidden Objects
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Find frogs tucked into hand-drawn scenes in Find the Frog - Hidden Objects. Click when you spot one and check the details of the black-and-white background for the rest.

pages.title: Fun Mini Games For Princess
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Choose a short activity in Fun Mini Games For Princess. Click or tap to try different games, switching between activities as you explore the collection.

pages.title: Jewel Solitaire TriPeaks
pages.creator: Mad Data
pages.description: Play card layouts to rebuild castles in Jewel Solitaire TriPeaks. Work through the levels and try twelve solitaire variants, including Klondike and Spider, as the kingdom takes shape.

pages.title: Shiny Jewels
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Match gems and use boosters in Shiny Jewels. Complete missions for rewards or try special events that ask you to collect coins within limited moves or beat the clock.

pages.title: Hero Merge
pages.creator: Stoneforge Games
pages.description: Combine heroes to create stronger defenders in Hero Merge. Place them where their attacks can cover the grid and keep building the lineup to protect your wall against enemy waves.

pages.title: Dynamons 10
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Explore the Gold Temple and a bonus cave in Dynamons 10. Encounter creatures such as Tyrexar and Cobragora, then develop your team through battles and new catches.

pages.title: Super Sprunki Clicker
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Tap to earn rewards and put together a band in Super Sprunki Clicker. Spend on upgrades and automatic clickers to change how quickly your music project grows.

pages.title: Timberland Arrange Puzzle Game
pages.creator: Expert Group FZCO
pages.description: Use intersecting clues to place animals in Timberland Arrange Puzzle Game. Work out where each one belongs and color it as you solve the illustrated logic board.

pages.title: Kawaii Realm Adventure
pages.creator: CGSpot
pages.description: Follow Sarah, Emma, Lily, and Mia through a portal in Kawaii Realm Adventure. Try makeup and clothes for their new two-dimensional forms after they reach the other side.

pages.title: Magic Solitaire
pages.creator: Rainbow Games
pages.description: Solve solitaire layouts in Magic Solitaire with help from a fairy. Play cards in settings such as a fireside tavern or a table beside a waterfall.

pages.title: Tap & Go Deluxe
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Tap to move and turn in Tap & Go Deluxe. Watch where the route bends and use each input at the right time to keep the run going.

pages.title: Draw To Kill
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Draw the path your character will follow in Draw To Kill. Study where the enemies are first, then choose a route that reaches them before they can stop you.

pages.title: Flight Pilot Airplane Games 24
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Pilot an aircraft past mountains, buildings, and other obstacles in Flight Pilot Airplane Games 24. Keep an eye on the terrain ahead as you steer along the flight route.

pages.title: Infantry Attack Battle 3D FPS
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Fight an invading force in Infantry Attack Battle 3D FPS. Use the shooting controls to take out incoming enemies and work through the combat objectives.

pages.title: Watermelon Suika Game
pages.creator: Momo Games
pages.description: Drop fruit into a box in Watermelon Suika Game. Make identical pieces touch to produce a larger fruit, and keep the growing pile from spilling out.

pages.title: Bus Track Masters
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Race buses through challenging courses in Bus Track Masters. Use the arrow keys or WASD and account for the size of the bus as you approach the next turn.

pages.title: Retro Space Blaster
pages.creator: CoolMath Games
pages.description: Blast UFOs and asteroids in Retro Space Blaster. Use the arrows to turn and fly the ship, and fire with space when a target lines up.

pages.title: Real Boxing Fighting Game
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Put on boxing gloves and take on street fighters in Real Boxing Fighting Game. Watch how opponents attack and work on your boxer's career as you fight.

pages.title: Battle Chess: Puzzle
pages.creator: DAPALAB
pages.description: Combine knights in Battle Chess: Puzzle before the other side can do the same. Think ahead because opponents move with you, and use the board to your advantage.

pages.title: Jump The Wall
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Jump walls in Jump The Wall while racing the other runners. Time each leap so you don't hit an obstacle or lose time after a fall.

pages.title: Bike Vs. Train
pages.creator: yes games studio
pages.description: Ride a motorcycle alongside trains in Bike Vs. Train. Judge where to accelerate or jump so the bike can get through the course's stunt sections.

pages.title: Tasty Drop
pages.creator: Gameloft SE
pages.description: Drop the final ingredient into a bowl in Tasty Drop. Study how it will bounce and roll through the setup, then choose a release point that lands it in the dish.

pages.title: Archer Master
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Practice aim across forty levels in Archer Master. Line up the target before releasing the arrow and try three bows as you work through the range.

pages.title: The Bonfire Forsaken Lands
pages.creator: Xigma Games
pages.description: Build a settlement in The Bonfire Forsaken Lands. Assign workers and gather supplies by day so you can survive monster attacks at night, then develop crafting and trade.

pages.title: Protect Emojis
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Draw shields to keep dangerous balls away in Protect Emojis. Drag a line around the characters and think about how it will sit when the attack begins.

pages.title: Island of Pirates
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Battle soldiers in Island of Pirates. Move around the island as a pirate fighter and work through the encounters with the blue-clad troops.

pages.title: World Flags Quiz
pages.creator: Misc.261 Games
pages.description: Match flags to country names in World Flags Quiz. Read the prompt and click or tap the flag that belongs to it as quickly as you can.

pages.title: Impostor Assassin
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Sneak through a spaceship in Impostor Assassin. Approach targets without being seen and keep the points you earn to unlock more characters.

pages.title: Money Fest
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Collect coins along the route in Money Fest. Choose operations that grow the total and steer around choices that would subtract from it or divide it.

pages.title: Sword Knight
pages.creator: Renan Games
pages.description: Find a way out of each area in Sword Knight. Work through obstacles and puzzles across three worlds, checking the route before moving into the next section.

pages.title: Sieger 2
pages.creator: Blaster
pages.description: Bring down forts in Sieger 2 with carefully placed explosives. Look for a weak point that can collapse the rest of the structure and earn a medal.

pages.title: Balloon Run
pages.creator: Rokito Games
pages.description: Pick up balloons of your color in Balloon Run to gain enough height for the next floor. Avoid the other colors, which deflate the balloon.

pages.title: Pinatamasters 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Break piñatas in Pinatamasters 2 and gather the money they drop. Upgrade weapons between attempts and try different tools on the remaining piñatas.

pages.title: Helicopter Black Ops 3D
pages.creator: TastyCherryGames
pages.description: Fly missions as a rogue pilot in Helicopter Black Ops 3D. Control the helicopter during combat and work through the assignments as the pilot searches for answers.

pages.title: Halloween Puzzles
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Restore twelve Halloween pictures in Halloween Puzzles. Drag squares into the right positions, using the characters' outlines and colors to see which pieces belong together.

pages.title: 3D Rubik
pages.creator: Gamesonline.co.id
pages.description: Turn rows and columns in 3D Rubik to solve the cube. Swipe to move its pieces and work toward making every face a solid color.

pages.title: SS Euro Cup 2021
pages.creator: Radical Play LLC
pages.description: Play eleven-a-side football in SS Euro Cup 2021. Drag to direct your player and release to kick, then look for space to move the ball upfield.

pages.title: Russian Taz Driving
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Drive Russian cars through city streets in Russian Taz Driving. Use WASD to steer, space to brake, and C to change the camera as you practice drifting.

pages.title: Ace Drift
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Drift through a series of bends in Ace Drift. Pick up gold coins while keeping the car on the road and spend them on other vehicle skins.

pages.title: Tiny Dungeons
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Run and jump through mazes in Tiny Dungeons. Watch for hazards before leaving a platform and help the small character get through each dangerous route.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Adventure Book
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Open stories about Hazel's adventures in Baby Hazel Adventure Book. Join activities such as festival celebrations, trips, and a chance to learn about being a doctor.

pages.title: Car Crusher Master
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Crush vehicles in Car Crusher Master. Clear each group of cars and use the rewards to unlock additional vehicles for the next round.

pages.title: Air Plane Parking 3d
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: Fly and park aircraft in Air Plane Parking 3d. Maneuver each vehicle with enough room to turn and line it up as you reach the designated parking area.

pages.title: Bottle Flip
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Flip a bottle in Bottle Flip and try to land it upright on the table. Adjust your timing with each attempt and see how high you can score.

pages.title: Little Rider
pages.creator: Pro_Gaming
pages.description: Take a motocross bike through uneven courses in Little Rider. Manage acceleration and braking and watch how the rider and suspension respond as the terrain changes.

pages.title: Fishing.io
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Fish for catches and treasure in Fishing.io. Spend what you earn on better nets to reach deeper water, and look for trapped characters as you explore.

pages.title: Cartoon Tractor Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble six tractor pictures in Cartoon Tractor Puzzle. Choose one of four piece counts and use details from the cartoon vehicle to work out the joins.

pages.title: Garbage Truck Sim 2020
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Pick up trash around town in Garbage Truck Sim 2020. Drive with WASD and take the load to the marked destination once you've collected it.

pages.title: Fill The Glass
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Guide water into a glass in Fill The Glass. Use the mouse to work with the layout and plan where the liquid will go before trying the solution.

pages.title: Johnny Megatone
pages.creator: Play.works
pages.description: Take Johnny through a two-dimensional platform adventure in Johnny Megatone. Work past the obstacles in his path as he tries to stop Mr. Z.

pages.title: Unicorn Cake Pops
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Make a unicorn-themed dessert in Unicorn Cake Pops. Use the mouse to work through the baking activities and finish the treats after preparing the cake.

pages.title: Monster Truck Memory
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Match truck pictures in Monster Truck Memory. Remember the positions of the tiles and clear each of the eight levels as quickly as you can.

pages.title: Princess E Girl Fashion
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Create e-girl looks for Elsa, Harley Quinn, and Moana in Princess E Girl Fashion. Try makeup and clothes for each character and compare how the styles turn out.

pages.title: Spider Solitaire
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Build runs in Spider Solitaire and clear the completed stacks. Choose a one-, two-, or four-suit game depending on how much variety you want in the cards.

pages.title: Cake House
pages.creator: TinyHand Studios
pages.description: Bake a creamy strawberry cake in Cake House. Pick the ingredients and follow the instructions for the order as you work through the recipe.

pages.title: Endless Survival Shooting
pages.creator: gameworld
pages.description: Stay alive against cartoon zombies in Endless Survival Shooting. Move with WASD and use the left mouse button to fire as you make room to deal with the next attacker.

pages.title: Stickman Fighter : Mega Brawl
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Fight stickmen and bosses in Stickman Fighter : Mega Brawl. Use your attacks and special skills as the next opponent approaches and keep fighting through the brawl.

pages.title: Findergarten Christmas
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Find the snippets from the right side in the full photo in Findergarten Christmas. Tap the matching part of the picture and locate every snippet to finish.

pages.title: Santa Hidden Presents
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Search for Santa's gifts in Santa Hidden Presents. Look closely for presents hidden in the holiday scenes and collect them all before time runs out.

pages.title: Fairy Dress Up
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Design fairy characters in Fairy Dress Up. Try dresses or skirts, choose a hairstyle, and finish each look with wings, jewelry, or a magic wand.

pages.title: Dream Boyfriend Maker
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Create a character in Dream Boyfriend Maker. Try modern clothes and see how different pieces work together before settling on the outfit you want.

pages.title: Water Hero Shoot
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Shoot opponents with water in Water Hero Shoot. Use the mouse to change their color and add them to your team as you move through the challenge.

pages.title: FZ Pixel Jumper
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Jump as high as possible in FZ Pixel Jumper. Watch your landings and the hazards ahead, and try characters with different abilities when you play again.

pages.title: Wall Avoid
pages.creator: DarknesGamesStudio
pages.description: Jump between walls in Wall Avoid. Tap to change sides at the right moment and see how long you can climb without falling or hitting danger.

pages.title: Car Eats Car: Dungeon Adventure
pages.creator: SMOKOKO LTD
pages.description: Race through hazards in Car Eats Car: Dungeon Adventure. Fight rivals, use the incubator to build cars, and work toward freeing the vehicles imprisoned along the way.

pages.title: Supra Drift 3D
pages.creator: Smartline-Games
pages.description: Customize a Toyota Supra in Supra Drift 3D. Choose the color and body kit, then take it out on the streets to practice drifting around corners.

pages.title: Dotted Girl Difference
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Compare two pictures in Dotted Girl Difference. Look for the details that have changed and find them all to move to another pair.

pages.title: Crazy Snake io
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Steer a snake with the mouse in Crazy Snake io. Press space or click to boost, try two game modes, and pick from the available skins.

pages.title: Koby Jump Escape
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Collect three money bags to open the door in Koby Jump Escape. Use the arrows or touch controls to get Koby through thirteen prison levels.

pages.title: Crazy Bikers Jigsaw
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Fit together twelve biker pictures in Crazy Bikers Jigsaw. Pick a layout with 25, 49, or 100 pieces and use details from each image to solve it.

pages.title: Ice Cream Maker
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Use the mouse to make a treat in Ice Cream Maker. Try the different ice cream designs and choose how you want the finished dessert to look.

pages.title: Crossy Bridge
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Time your clicks to keep the crossing open in Crossy Bridge. Watch the moving sections and line them up so the vehicle can make it across.

pages.title: Bricks
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Set off chain reactions in Bricks. Aim shots at the balls and use each blast to reach more targets, since you get only a limited number of bullets.

pages.title: Blocky Gun Paintball 2
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Take on rival players in Blocky Gun Paintball 2. Move through a block-built arena and use your chosen weapon to get shots off as opponents appear.

pages.title: Jims World Adventure
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Help Jim search for treasure in Jims World Adventure. Move through classic platforming layouts and watch for hazards as he makes his way across each stage.

pages.title: EG Mr.Dubstep
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Move around colorful obstacles in EG Mr.Dubstep. Adjust as the course changes and work through the platforming levels that open along the way.

pages.title: Xmas Slope
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Slide through a snowy pine forest in Xmas Slope. Guide Santa along the slippery route and steer toward the gifts he needs to collect.

pages.title: Tap For Money Restaurant
pages.creator: Bofer Media (Twim Studio)
pages.description: Build up a restaurant business in Tap For Money Restaurant. Tap to increase your earnings and use the money to open restaurants in more cities.

pages.title: Stunt Simulator Multiplayer
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Drive stunts and drifts for points in Stunt Simulator Multiplayer. Use the keyboard to control your car and spend what you earn to buy other vehicles.

pages.title: Number Crunch Multiplication
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Practice multiplication while matching tiles in Number Crunch Multiplication. Pay attention to the numbers and use the arithmetic alongside the board's matching rules.

pages.title: Plane Master
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Dodge guided missiles in Plane Master. Steer the plane through enemy territory and try to make pursuing missiles hit one another as you stay in the air.

pages.title: Geisha make up and dress up
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Style a young geisha in Geisha make up and dress up. Pick makeup accessories and Japanese clothes, then see how your choices look together.

pages.title: Dinosaurs World Hidden Eggs II
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Find hidden eggs in Dinosaurs World Hidden Eggs II. Click the eggs you spot across five timed scenes and try to finish each search before time expires.

pages.title: Crazy Pistol
pages.creator: ESERGAMES
pages.description: Aim at targets in Crazy Pistol. Watch what is in front of you, then fire when you have a clear shot and work on your accuracy.

pages.title: Arithmetic Game
pages.creator: Novel Games Limited
pages.description: Find numbers in the grid in Arithmetic Game to complete the equation shown below. Check how the operation connects the values before selecting your answer.

pages.title: Skatelander
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Skate through an endless world in Skatelander. Watch for what's ahead, keep the board moving, and see how far you can go through the changing surroundings.

pages.title: Bomb The Mountain
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Hop across designated areas with B-Pop in Bomb The Mountain. Follow the mission instructions and avoid electricity, roads, and lava as you move through the mountain.

pages.title: Egyptian Stones
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Connect stones with the same symbol in Egyptian Stones. Watch for frozen pieces and bombs that affect the board, and use power-ups to reveal a match or disarm a stone.

pages.title: Tea Treatment
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Give the character a spa session in Tea Treatment. Use the mouse to apply the masks and facial steam, then try the dress-up choices after the treatment.

pages.title: Pizza Bar
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Make pizzas to order in Pizza Bar. Check the toppings customers ask for and put together the right combinations before sending out the finished slices.

pages.title: Ice Princess Wedding Day
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Plan a ceremony in Ice Princess Wedding Day. Style the bride, help the groom find his belongings, and decorate the ballroom for the celebration.
